title: World edge and shore (public/tiles/<world>/boundary.json), local metres (+x east, +z south)

edges.description: The outline of the built tiles, built tiles on the left of travel. land: the world stops on dry ground (the sim walls it off; there is no ground beyond). water: the outline crosses open water.

closed.description: A whole outline loop of one kind: the last point joins the first

shore.description: Land/water lines inside the built tiles, land on the left of travel: the sea-wall line and the Bay-edge refill zone. Open lines end at the edge of the built tiles. Inland lakes are water too: each one's outline is a closed line tagged with the lake.

lake.description: Optional: the inland lake (its id, as in the tile colliders' ground.lakes) this closed ring goes round (world QA W-11). Absent on the sea's lines.
